params.name: sector
params.description: Sector name to build the index from. Provide exactly one of `sector`, `vertical`, or `scope=overall`. Use `/composite-index/sectors` for valid names.

params.name: vertical
params.description: Vertical name to build the index from. Provide exactly one of `sector`, `vertical`, or `scope=overall`. Use `/composite-index/verticals` for valid names.

params.name: scope
params.description: Set to `overall` for the Caplight Top 20 — the flagship private-market index across all sectors (the 20 most liquid private companies, price-per-share weighted, monthly rebalance). Cannot be combined with `sector` or `vertical`.

params.name: startDate
params.description: Start date for the timeseries. Defaults to 1 year ago.

params.name: endDate
params.description: End date for the timeseries. Defaults to yesterday.

items.docs: Returns a market-cap weighted composite index timeseries for private companies in a given sector or vertical, or the overall Caplight Top 20 (`scope=overall`). The index is rebased to 100 on the start date; each day includes the constituent list and weights. Companies that exit the private market (M&A, IPO, or wind-down) are excluded after their exit date. Only the parameters documented below are accepted — any other parameter is rejected with a 400 so index values are never silently computed un
Returns a list of all active sector names that can be used with the composite index endpoint.

params.name: sector
params.description: Filter verticals by sector name. Must be a valid sector (use /composite-index/sectors to list).

items.docs: Returns a list of all active verticals with their parent sector names. Optionally filter by sector.
